title: Align company OKR to customer-facing initiative waves and cross-team staging
text:
Align company OKR to customer-facing initiative waves and cross-team staging

description:
Goal: Convert the high-level company OKR (Improve production inference efficiency by 30% and customer adoption of dedicated plans by 2x) into a time-phased set of customer-facing initiative waves and a cross-team staging plan that ensures predictable delivery and measurable outcomes.

Scope: Define initiative waves (Wave A: runtime efficiency quick wins, Wave B: Dedicated onboarding tools, Wave C: Console observability and billing insights), assign owners, surface cross-team dependencies (Serving, Dedicated, Console, Sales Ops), create a risk register, and publish a roll-up dashboard that maps initiative milestones to OKR key results.

Background: Leadership prioritized production economics as the company north star for 2026. PMs, Eng leads, and Design have proposed >10 candidate initiatives. We need a single coordinated plan so Sales, Customer Success, and Engineering can align scoping, capacity commits, and release gates. Previous quarter had fragmented initiative launches that diluted metric signals; this ticket consolidates the approach into waves with explicit staging rules and fallback policies.

Trade-offs discussed: 1) Aggressive parallel launches speed time-to-value but increase integration risk; chosen compromise is a prioritized wave model with a single high-risk pilot per wave. 2) Tight coupling to Dedicated capacity commitments improves predictability but may delay shipped customer features — mitigated by defining feature toggles and public fallback routes to hosted variants.

Deliverables:
- Wave definitions with scope and milestones
- RACI table (owners + reviewers)
- Cross-team dependency matrix and mitigation actions
- Roll-up dashboard prototype (OKR -> initiative -> milestone -> metric)
- Staging & rollback runbook for each wave

Success metrics: mapping in roll-up dashboard showing attribution from initiatives to OKR KRs, and a validated staging run with canary sign-offs for Wave A by 2026-03-24.

acceptance_criteria:
Each company OKR key result has 1–3 mapped initiatives with owners
Wave schedule published and signed by Eng, Product, and Sales leads
Dependency register with mitigation and owners created
Roll-up dashboard MVP deployed and connected to primary metrics (latency p50/p95, cost per 1k tokens, Dedicated adoption rate)
Staging runbook with canary gates and rollback instructions reviewed and accepted
